subject.title: Named profiles migrate approval state from the default profile

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102883 land with non-default `OPENCLAW_PROFILE` treated as an approval-state migration boundary while preserving bare `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` relocation?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix touches approval trust state, profile isolation, and shipped migration behavior, which repository policy treats as security- and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Land the linked guard
options.body: Accept the linked PR's profile-aware migration boundary and keep the issue open only until that PR merges.

options.title: Ask for more upgrade proof
options.body: Request additional packaged macOS or CLI proof showing default-profile approval files remain untouched while bare relocation still migrates.

options.title: Reject and redesign
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a different migration boundary if the linked PR is not the intended compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Land the linked guard
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR's profile-aware migration boundary and keep the issue open only until that PR merges.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete is the issue assignee, official maintainer listed in CONTRIBUTING.md, and author of the open fix candidate.
